नागा चैतन्य पूरे 40 साल के हो गए हैं इस खास मौके पर।
शोभिता धूलिपाला ने अपने 'लवर' के लिए एक प्यारा बर्थडे पोस्ट शेयर किया है।
इस पोस्ट में दोनों की बेहद कोजी और खूबसूरत तस्वीरें नजर आ रही हैं।
फैंस के बीच इन रोमांटिक तस्वीरों की चर्चा काफी तेज हो गई है।
क्या आपको भी इनकी जोड़ी बॉलीवुड और साउथ की सबसे क्यूट जोड़ी लगती है? 👇

ctx.title: Naga Chaitanya Turns 40: Sobhita Dhulipala pens a heartwarming birthday post for her 'lover', shares cozy photos
ctx.summary:
Actress Sobhita Dhulipala made her husband-actor  Naga Chaitanya 's 40th birthday extra special with a sweet social media tribute. The actress shared a series of loved-up pictures featuring the couple, giving fans a glimpse into their romantic bond. Keeping her birthday wish short and affectionate, Sobhita addressed her husband as her 'lover', leaving fans gushing over their adorable chemistry. Naga Chaitanya completes 40 years on November 23, 2026. 
 Sobhita Dhulipala's birthday wish for Naga Chaitanya 
 Sharing the pictures on social media,  Sobhita Dhulipala  wrote, "Happy birthday lover." One photograph captured the couple sharing a kiss, while another showed Naga Chaitanya having fun with a magic mirror that displayed a multi-dimensional portrait of the actor. The candid moments offer a glimpse into their happy married life. 
 Check out her post below: 
   Sobhita and Naga Chaitanya's married life 
 The couple tied the knot in December 2024 in a traditional Telugu wedding ceremony at Annapurna Studios in Hyderabad. Sobhita had opened up about balancing her professional commitments and married life. She revealed in an interview that she left for a shoot in Tamil Nadu just weeks after their wedding and ended up spending more than 150 days there.
